 Why fix it? Chopra urges RCB to keep winning squad
 By News Desk 
 Tuesday, 17 November 2026, 14:03:09 IST 
 0 
 Facebook WhatsApp X Telegram 
 Former India batter Aakash Chopra has urged Royal Challengers Bengaluru to retain their championship-winning core ahead of the upcoming player retention deadline. 
 The defending champions face a straightforward retention process following their back-to-back title victories in the prestigious T20 league. 
 Chopra believes the franchise must maintain continuity instead of making sweeping changes to a squad that clearly delivers consistent results. 
 He specifically backed retaining all-rounder Romario Shepherd despite his occasional inconsistencies because his modest price tag protects the team purse. 
 The cricket expert noted that acquiring the explosive player cheaply makes him a valuable asset for the squad. 
 Regarding fast bowler Josh Hazlewood, Chopra suggested that the franchise must discuss availability directly with the Australian star. 
 If the pacer commits to playing even a portion of the tournament, the management should definitely keep him in the squad. 
 Chopra also highlighted left-arm fast bowler Yash Dayal as another individual player requiring some careful internal consideration before final decisions. 
 Ultimately, the former cricketer feels the successful Bengaluru franchise should preserve their settled combination to chase a historic third consecutive title.
